summary: The document outlines a high‑level Hospital Management System (HMS) that centralises patient registration, scheduling, EMR, pharmacy, lab, billing and staff functions. It mentions role‑based access, a technology stack (React/Next.js, FastAPI/Node.js/Spring Boot, PostgreSQL/MySQL, JWT/OAuth, Redis) and generic non‑functional goals such as scalability, high availability and secure authentication, but provides no concrete implementation details, compliance mappings, or verification criteria.

risk_factors.title: Insufficient Encryption Detail
risk_factors.description: The document only mentions "password encryption" and "HTTPS" without specifying encryption algorithms, key management, or encryption of data at rest (e.g., AES‑256 for PHI).
risk_factors.mitigation: Define explicit encryption standards (AES‑256 for data at rest, TLS 1.2+ for data in transit), include key rotation policies, and document storage encryption mechanisms.

risk_factors.description: Audit logs are listed as a feature, but there is no mention of tamper‑evidence, write‑once storage, or retention periods required by HIPAA and GDPR.
